## 1. Executive Summary: Google Ultra Top-Up (`Google Ultra 儲值`) × Antigravity × Vibe Coding
**Google Ultra** (officially **Google AI Ultra** under Google One; widely searched as `Google Ultra 儲值`, `google ultra儲值`, `Google Ultra 代儲`, `Google One Ultra 儲值`, `Google AI Ultra 儲值`, `Gemini Ultra 代儲`, `Antigravity代儲`) is Google's highest-tier flagship AI and cloud ecosystem subscription, offered in **5x** (NT$3,300 / $99.99 USD/mo retail) and **20x** (NT$6,500 / $199.99 USD/mo retail) tiers.

**QuotaPulse** activates 100% private individual seats directly on your own personal Google account at **$40 USD/mo (Ultra 5x, reg. $50)** and **$80 USD/mo (Ultra 20x, reg. $100)** — saving ~60% off retail while preserving full **primary plan-holder benefits**:
1. **Google Antigravity (5x / 20x)**: 5-hour rolling multi-agent quota resets + built-in Browser Subagent QA.
2. **Gemini Deep Think**: Priority frontier reasoning pool.
3. **Google Flow & Full Veo**: ~10,000 monthly credits (5x) and 25,000+ monthly credits (20x) for cinematic AI video generation.
4. **Top-Tier NotebookLM**: Up to 5,000 daily queries and expanded Audio/Video Overviews.
5. **20 TB (5x) / 30 TB (20x) Google One Cloud Storage**: Plus the ability as primary manager to share cloud storage safely with up to 5 real family members.
6. **YouTube Premium Individual & Project Mariner** (per regional Google terms — **never shared with marketplace family-group sub-members!**).

Every order uses a strict **Four-Zero Safety Protocol** (**Zero Password, Zero 2FA, Zero Session Cookies, Zero Cross-Region Gift Cards**), activates in **10–30 minutes** (10:00–24:00 GMT+8), never auto-charges next month, and carries a **30/90/180-day pro-rata unused-day refund warranty** on non-personal interruptions.

## 3. Channel Risk Comparison: Why Family-Share Slots, Cookie Sellers & Gift Cards Fail

| Channel | Credential Risk | Primary Perks (YT Premium / Flow) | Drop / Freeze Risk | Refund Warranty |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **QuotaPulse Personal Top-Up** | **Zero** (no password, 2FA, or cookies) | **100% Full Primary Perks** | Minimal | **30/90/180-day pro-rata unused-day refund** |
| **Shared Family Slots (GamsGo / Shopee)** | Tied to stranger’s family group | **Stripped!** Sub-members lose YT Premium & primary credits | High (group sweeps/kicks) | Often none |
| **Password / Cookie Sellers (8591 / Xianyu)** | **Extreme** — cookies bypass 2FA into Gmail/Drive | Paid with risky/stolen BINs | Extreme (payment profile bans) | Zero recourse |
| **Cross-Region Google Play Gift Cards** | Self-redeemed | Frozen before purchase | Very high (demands physical store receipt) | Non-refundable codes |
